definitions.gain_pct: 100 x (mean rule - mean SLAB seed mean) / mean rule; positive = SLAB shorter; rule = the better of SPT and LLF by mean makespan on that set
definitions.n_slab_shorter/equal/longer: orders on which the SLAB seed mean (mean over seeds 301-303) is shorter than, equal to or longer than that rule
definitions.wilcoxon_p: two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank test of SLAB seed mean - rule, zeros dropped (stats_tests.wilcoxon_paired)
definitions.wilcoxon_p_holm: Holm adjustment over all rows of this summary
definitions.rank_biserial_r: matched-pairs rank-biserial correlation of SLAB seed mean - rule (stats_tests.rank_biserial); r < 0 favours SLAB
definitions.sigma_spt: mean over orders of Q / (Q + W) on the SPT schedule
definitions.sigma_spt_pooled: sum Q / sum (Q + W) over the orders of the set, SPT schedule
definitions.change_vs_nominal_pct: 100 x (mean makespan on the set / mean makespan on the nominal twins - 1)
